pos.personaBrief: Lance (2023-11-02) describes Diniz's 'unique style of dominating possession through short build-up', and Lugano says Fluminense wraps the rival with touches from the back, so the ball is the centre of the game plan.

pro.personaBrief: Lugano notes Fluminense keeps the ball at the back to draw the press and 'arriesga bastante más' near its own box; short build-up (Lance) is the route forward, with speed only in the last third.

est.personaBrief: The 'aposicional' system gives players 'total liberdade de movimentação' to approach the ball (Lance 2023-11-02), with no fixed positions and high mobility (Lugano): clearly relational.

lar.personaBrief: No verified 2023 width evidence; from general knowledge, Diniz's Fluminense overloaded near the ball with wingers (Arias, Keno) drifting inside and Ganso as the central brain, consistent with the verified aposicional, close-combination play.

blo.personaBrief: No verified 2023 block evidence; from general knowledge (and the unverified Blizzard note on immediate counter-pressing), Fluminense pressed aggressively after losing the ball, though Diniz says (2025) it also defended in medium and low lines, as v Boca with ten men.

mar.personaBrief: No verified 2023 marking evidence; from general knowledge Diniz's teams defend in a man-oriented way when pressing, in line with the Lance speculation of André tracking Barco individually.

pla.personaBrief: Lance (2023-11-02) says Diniz 'não costuma adaptar o seu time ao adversário', and while Lance (2023-11-03) notes he adapted when needed, 'Dinizismo' as a fixed identity dominates; he also built around the players he found (Ganso revived).

res.personaBrief: Diniz's own 2023 quote ('Campeão é quem vive com dignidade...') puts how you compete above the score, and the risky style near his own box shows he plays to win in his way rather than to protect results.

sis.personaBrief: Diniz 'potencializar os principais jogadores (André, Ganso, Arias e Cano)' and gives total freedom of movement (Lance), trusting talent like Ganso, whom he rated above Xavi.

jog.personaBrief: The team was built around Ganso's technique (Lance 2023-11-02) and even used Felipe Melo, a passing volante, at centre-back despite mobility criticism (Correio), so technique beats physicality.

bas.personaBrief: The 2023 core leaned on veterans (Felipe Melo, Marcelo, Ganso, Cano, the oldest Libertadores-winning keeper Fábio per Correio/Blizzard), while young academy players such as André also played key roles.

lid.personaBrief: Lance (2023-11-03) frames Diniz's relationship as 'entre tapas e beijos' and says he made players 'evoluírem mentalmente', reviving Ganso: a people-centred coach who is also demanding.
